description: List per-user feature grants, newest first, at most 100: filter by flag, by user id or by exact account email. Users appear only as numeric ids, never with an email, a name or the grant reason. With a user filter the result also lists that user's roles. Admins only. Requires signing in (admin:features).

email.description: Only this user's grants and roles, by exact account email. The result shows the user id, never the email.

flag.description: Only grants for this feature flag, for example "artifacts".

userId.description: Only this user's grants and roles, by numeric user id.

name: list_feature_access
title: List feature grants (admin)
